By folding the gains back into the weave, they turned a meager start into a tapestry that draped the stars. They learned that in the dance of exchange, the refusal to hoard is the key to the treasure. To give is to multiply; to return is to sustain. Thus, the weavers thrived, forever bound by the invisible, golden threads of their mutual, unwavering trust.
